title: RETRACTION: Biochemical Control of Alternaria Tenuissima Infecting Post‐Harvest Fig Fruit by Chickpea Vicilin
content:
RETRACTION: E. Abbas, A. Osman and M. Sitohy, “ Biochemical Control of Alternaria Tenuissima Infecting Post-Harvest Fig Fruit by Chickpea Vicilin,” Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture 100, no. 7 (2020): 2889-2897, https://doi.org/10.1002/jsfa.10314.

The above article, published online on 07 February 2020 in Wiley Online Library (wileyonlinelibrary.com), has been retracted by agreement between the journal Editors-in-Chief, Sandra Schmöckel and Andrew Waterhouse; the Society of Chemical Industry; and John Wiley & Sons Ltd.

The retraction has been agreed upon following concerns raised by a third party. An investigation identified duplication between SDS-PAGE electrophoresis bands presented in Figure 2 of this article and bands published in an earlier article by some of the same authors, although the bands were reported to represent different protein samples and experiments. Furthermore, evidence of splicing was identified between lanes “St” and “1”, and between lanes “1” and “2”. The authors cooperated with the investigation and provided some supporting data but were unable to produce any raw data for Figure 2. In light of the image concerns identified and the absence of underlying raw data, the editors consider the results and conclusions of this article to be unreliable. The authors disagree with the retraction. © 2026 Society of Chemical Industry.
